purpose: Repeat the path-enum named-tool canary after the attempt-6 memory-admission rejection, lowering the memory fraction slightly to leave reliable space for the active desktop compositor on GPU0.

passCriteria: exactly one read_file call with valid call id and pathMatchesContract=true
exactly one write_file call with valid call id, pathMatchesContract=true and contentMatchesFixture=true
nonempty final answer without extra tool call

failurePolicy: One run only, no automatic retry and no Tool-Eval. If startup admission still fails, review GPU desktop processes and configuration before deciding on any further action.
